## A-Share Quant 1.0.0

First public release of the desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux) and Docker image. The system collects market data, news and social hot lists for China A-shares, analyzes sentiment with an LLM, scores limit-up candidates with a weighted multi-factor model, and turns signals into paper-trading orders.

### Highlights

- **Data collection with fallbacks:** quotes, limit-up pools, dragon-tiger lists, fund flows, news (Cailianshe, Xueqiu, Jiuyan, RSS), social hot lists, US markets and global news. Every source falls back to alternatives, with circuit breakers and a live data-source status page.
- **Market analysis:** market regime (attack / balanced / defensive / freeze) that scales position size, theme tracking with leaders and stages, LLM market review with next-day plan, and six full-market screening strategies with backtests.
- **AI stock diagnosis:** multi-analyst diagnosis covering technicals, fund flow, chips, earnings, news, shareholders and market phase, with price plans, guardrails, three decision profiles and accuracy calibration from past outcomes.
- **AI chat, deep research and decision signals:** streaming multi-turn Q&A backed by read-only data tools, cited research reports, and decision signals that are tracked and evaluated after the fact.
- **Trading and accounts:** paper trading with T+1 and automatic stop-loss / take-profit orders, real-account bookkeeping with multiple accounts and corporate actions, portfolio risk and intraday alerts with custom indicator rules.
- **Notifications and bots:** daily reports and alerts to WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, email, Telegram, Discord, Slack and more; chat bots on DingTalk, Feishu and Discord.
- **Any LLM:** Claude, Gemini, Ollama and every OpenAI-compatible provider through LiteLLM, with key rotation, error diagnosis and usage/cost tracking. UI in Chinese or English; AI output language configurable separately.

### Fixed in this release

- Pages could no longer be opened after one page crashed (the whole UI went blank). Page errors are now contained to the content area, and the crashes in the news feed, the AI chat and the dashboard API were fixed.
- A fresh install on a non-trading day (weekend, holiday) had no market data, no stock search and an empty dashboard. "Collect data" now backfills the last trading day, the stock list loads at startup, and the dashboard falls back to the most recent trading day.
- The packaged app could not find its bundled Chromium, so browser-based sources always failed.
- Failed background tasks (e.g. no LLM key configured) reported success; they now show the actual reason.
- The macOS app is now ad-hoc signed, so downloaded copies no longer report "damaged".
